scope: W1 static and modeled platform logic; no Windows runtime

config.nsisSetup: not configured or built; portable uses the existing NSIS self-extracting launcher

findings.result: Node path.join/path.resolve and loadFile, no runtime /Users literal; file contents pass through IPC instead of POSIX path parsing
open-file and activate are mac lifecycle paths; Windows/Linux argv .json path is handled separately; suffix check is case-sensitive, so uppercase .JSON launch remains a W2 edge case
Blob/download and file inputs; web Save picker is gated off for file: desktop; no Windows shell command for exports

sanitize only download suggestions: Windows reserved characters and controls, reserved device names, leading spaces, trailing dots/spaces, empty fallback; JSON and embedded PNG/PDF payload remain unchanged
Ctrl or Meta save/undo/redo/formatting; native roles and existing accelerators preserved; no application-level Ctrl+O exists upstream; tooltips say Ctrl/Cmd rather than Cmd only
translates existing Electron menu instead of installing Mac layout; Windows-like menu model retains Ctrl/Alt accelerators, native Windows execution unverified
compositionstart/compositionend, isComposing and keyCode 229, not gated on macOS; actual Microsoft IME pending
Microsoft YaHei then system-ui/sans-serif fallback; Segoe UI can be selected by Windows system-ui; no new font file or CSS change
no hardcoded deviceScaleFactor; application zoom differs from system scaling; Windows 100/125/150 percent unverified
HTML data-theme variables and existing local preference; WebKit scrollbar rules apply to Chromium, not a Mac-only native theme dependency
UTF-8 sources; .env trim accepts CRLF; paste normalizes CRLF/CR; no global CRLF conversion

launcher extracts to temp and sets PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR; app does not redirect userData to EXE folder, so portable means no installer, not all preferences travel with the EXE; actual Windows path pending W2
no Authenticode table on outer/inner EXE; SmartScreen/Defender behavior not tested
